h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rajahmundry

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rajahmundry

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Rajahmundry

c: Rajahmundry has a long riverfront along the Godavari, and walkers there are already out at sunrise. That habit makes the city a natural place for open gyms on promenades, in municipal parks and in housing colonies. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to Rajahmundry from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 970 km away by road.

We manufacture every frame, seat and handle in-house. Each station is a standalone unit, so you can start with a few along a path and add more later without changing what is already there. Installation is done by our team or a dealer near you. Where the ground is firm we grout the posts, and on paved areas a self-standing frame can work. We will suggest the right method after seeing photos of your site.

richText.heading: Choosing machines for a riverside walking track

items.q: Can open gym machines be installed on a paved promenade?
items.a: Yes. On paved or concrete surfaces we can use a self-standing frame or grout the posts, depending on the thickness of the base. Photos of the surface help us decide.

items.q: How many machines should a park in Rajahmundry start with?
items.a: That depends on the space and footfall. Many parks begin with four to six stations and add more later, because each one stands on its own base.

items.q: Who installs the equipment in Andhra Pradesh?
items.a: Our installation team or a local dealer. We dispatch from Vasai by road, and the installer sets each machine according to the approved layout drawing.
